meta.title: U.S. House Election 2022
meta.subtitle: Equal-area district cartogram, 118th Congress
meta.method: After Karim Douieb, 'A better U.S. house election results map?' -- states rescaled so area is proportional to seat count, each state subdivided into equal-area cells, cells matched to districts by minimum-cost assignment.
meta.coordinateSpace: Pixels in a 1152 x 748.8 frame, y increasing downward. Ready for SVG.
meta.projection: US Albers composite with AK/HI insets (mapshaper -proj albersusa), fitted to the frame

render.cartogram: draw district.cell, then apply the state's cartogram transform: x*scale+tx, y*scale+ty
render.morph: interpolate district.geo -> district.cell (e.g. flubber), largest part first

sources.geography: US Census Bureau cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_cd118_500k
